title:
$1.5M condo:
*The salary you need*

lines.say: You want a 1.5 million dollar condo. Here's the salary the bank needs to see.
With a 75% loan, you borrow about 1.125 million dollars.
Banks test your loan at 4% interest, not today's rate. Over 30 years, that's about 5,400 dollars a month.
Your total debts can't go above 55% of your income. So you need about 9,800 dollars a month, with no other loans.
Got a car loan? Every dollar of it raises that number.
Then the upfront: 25% down, at least 5% in cash, plus about 44,600 dollars in stamp duty.
Comment plan and we'll send you the calculator used in this video.

caption:
Want a $1.5M condo? Here's the salary the bank needs to see. 🏙️

With a 75% loan you borrow about $1.125M. Banks test the loan at 4% interest, not today's rate: about $5,400 a month over 30 years. Total debts can't exceed 55% of income, so you need about $9,800 a month with no other loans. A car loan raises that number.

Upfront: 25% down (at least 5% in cash) plus about $44,600 in buyer's stamp duty.

Comment PLAN and we'll send you the calculator used in this video 👇

Illustration only: 30 year loan, no other debts. Bank policies vary.
